tasks.short: Inform and educate the public about fire prevention

steps.what: Select current fire prevention guidance for the audience
Assemble selected guidance into public education materials
Check prevention advice, examples and accessibility before use
Inform and educate the public on fire prevention and answer questions

tasks.design: Configure reusable, source-linked education sections in {DOCS} for the firefighter to select and assemble. Check the final pack before use and retain all public explanation, demonstration and question time; unfamiliar questions go to a qualified colleague rather than generated advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current standard advice is repeatedly copied into handouts or slides.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable sections can reduce assembly without rewriting safety advice or automating public interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining advice accessibly and recognising when an audience question needs specialist context.
tasks.human_edge: The firefighter can check understanding, demonstrate a point and respond to a concern empathetically.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated material preparation; public education and editorial responsibility stay human.

reach.task: Clarify a prevention question outside standard public guidance
reach.learn: Referral boundaries and current guidance interpretation

evidence.claim: Reusable document sections can reduce repeated assembly of already selected prevention guidance; the time allocation is an unmeasured scenario.
Public-information AI-text disclosure has an exception where a person holds editorial responsibility; this design retains a person's editorial check and introduces no generated advice.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and delivery of public prevention education, not incident response or individual building approval.
Firefighter in s1 produces audience, topic, selected section identifiers, exact current source versions and requested format. Full 15 hours include checking currency and recording selections.
Retained s2 time includes current detail entry, accessibility edits and manual handling of missing sections. No unproduced audience profile, risk score or auto-extracted safety advice is assumed.
S3 checks advice meaning, source currency, examples, exclusions and accessibility. S4 uses only that exact checked version; new factual advice requires a fresh check or specialist referral.
Test native section reuse before custom code. Existing material reuse earns no incremental saving; only observed repeated assembly shrinks.
unknowns: Current preparation burden and approved materials
Editorial release authority and accessibility requirements
research_questions: Does section reuse reduce assembly while preserving safety qualifications and audience understanding?

already_counted.description: Pack entry and manual formatting exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain reusable sections and check guidance versions

approvals.approved_version: Exact education-pack version with selected source versions, wording, examples and audience format; content changes void approval and unscripted advice stays within checked guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=15+6+10+60=91 give gross 9; less 2 upkeep gives net 7. High requires repeatable standard packs. Low assumes bespoke sessions remove only 2 hours of assembly, consumed by upkeep. Source selection, review and public delivery retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Orient to a fire and collect dropped supplies

steps.what: Orient self in relation to fire using compass and map
Collect supplies and equipment dropped by parachute within incident instructions

tasks.design: Retain map-and-compass orientation and physical retrieval with the firefighter. Existing incident references in {DOCS} may support training; this design adds no automatic navigation, drop tracking or retrieval equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The firefighter must interpret terrain and fire conditions and physically collect supplies.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest contains no capability that removes this physical and situational work.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling location uncertainty and changing conditions with incident instructions.
tasks.human_edge: The firefighter can recognise unsafe retrieval conditions and communicate a difficulty.
tasks.altitude: No change to operational authority, orientation or physical collection effort.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of firefighting and prevention workers
reach.task: Resolve a reported retrieval or location difficulty
reach.learn: Location uncertainty communication and command boundaries

evidence.claim: Map-and-compass orientation and collecting supplies remain situational and physical work; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: This US-shaped task applies only where the organisation actually performs such retrieval; it is not assumed typical of every European fire service.
Boundary is orientation and collection, not parachute-drop planning or dispatch.
Firefighter produces orientation understanding in s1 before collection in s2; no structured safe route or exact drop coordinates are assumed.
Review native references before any future custom work. No new tool or dataset is introduced, justifying zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether parachute-supply retrieval exists in the local role
research_questions: Is this task applicable locally, and how is location uncertainty handled during it?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero net saving. Where applicable, straightforward and difficult retrievals retain orientation and collection time; inapplicability creates no automation saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated public-education pack assembly while retaining editorial checks, public engagement and all operational retrieval work.
reach: Route specialist prevention questions to fire inspectors with clear source context
role.ambitious_version: A firefighter who can prepare consistent public guidance and explain its limits while retaining operational judgement.
